# Code Anchors: Install Location

- `libs/portable-tools/src/install-location.ts` — resolves the configuration directory from the environment variable with the home-based default, errors on a set-but-unusable value, creates an absent-but-resolvable location, and inspects which of the two contents it currently holds. Waived to name the loaded directory, for that home-based default alone.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/install-location.spec.ts` — resolution cases: unset, absolute, empty, non-absolute, unresolvable home; plus the inspection of each content.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the `install` and `uninstall` verbs and the location-and-content disclosure both print before changing anything, plus the printed permission-allowlist block. The pointing branch's own sites are listed under pointing-install.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/install-verb.spec.ts` — the install verb end to end: the copying mode, the reported location, and the settings-file before/after comparison.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/uninstall-verb.spec.ts` — the removal verb: emptying a copied set, and the disclosure printed first.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/allowlist.ts` — the single definition of the two permission-allowlist entries the install verb prints.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/allowlist-docs.spec.ts` — pins that block byte-identical across the install verb's output, the install documentation, and the upgrade section.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/supported-arrangement.spec.ts` — fails the build if any shipped component body instructs an adopter into the per-repository arrangement.
- `README.md` — the Installing and Upgrading sections carrying the two allowlist entries an adopter adds by hand.
